page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.26xlarge is a high-capacity storage and memory-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, this instance features 104 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. This dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per core. A key hardware feature of the ecs.i3.26xlarge is its massive local storage capacity, which includes 23,038 GB of bundled SSD storage. This high-density local solid-state storage is designed to handle intensive I/O operations directly on the host.

For connectivity, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. Given the combination of high-capacity local SSD storage, substantial memory, and 104 dedicated cores, the ecs.i3.26xlarge is engineered for demanding workloads. It is highly suitable for large-scale relational and non-relational databases, data warehousing, big data analytics, and distributed file systems that require low-latency access to massive local datasets.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.26xlarge is a high-capacity, storage-optimized instance designed for data-intensive workloads. Running on the KVM hypervisor, it features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with 104 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, operating at 2.5 GHz with a single thread per core. The hardware configuration includes 768.0 GB of RAM, offering 7.38 GB per core, alongside a massive 23,038 GB of bundled local SSD storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. Lacking a GPU, this instance is optimized for high-throughput, low-latency storage operations and memory-heavy processing. It is highly suited for large-scale databases, data warehousing, and big data analytics platforms requiring substantial local storage capacity and dedicated compute resources.
